# Story Package: Pentecost – The Holy Spirit Comes (Acts 2)

**Story Key**: `pentecost`

**Position in 365 Roadmap**: Phase 6, Story #28 — The Helper Jesus promised has come to live in us every day.

---

## Reverent Read-Aloud Retelling (for ages 3–8)

After Jesus went back to heaven, His friends were all together in one room in Jerusalem. They were waiting, just as Jesus had told them to do.

Suddenly, a sound like a strong wind came from heaven and filled the whole house. Then something like flames of fire appeared and rested on each of them. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they began to speak in different languages — languages they had never learned!

A big crowd of people from many different countries had come to Jerusalem for a special holiday. When they heard the sound, they came running. They were amazed because each person heard the disciples speaking in their own language!

Peter stood up and spoke to the crowd. He told them about Jesus — how He had died and risen again, and how God had made Him Lord. Peter said, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.”

That day about three thousand people believed in Jesus and were baptized. The Holy Spirit had come, just as Jesus promised. He came to live inside His people, to help them, comfort them, and give them power to live for God every single day.

---

## Coloring Page Prompt

Joyful black-and-white line art for ages 3–8. A group of people in a room with gentle flames like fire resting above their heads. A strong wind blowing. Outside, a big crowd of people from many lands looking surprised and happy. Soft, bright, and exciting feeling. Clean bold lines with large open spaces.

---

## Read-Along Flow

Color the flames and the happy crowd → listen to the story of the Holy Spirit coming to live in us → remember that the Helper Jesus promised is with us every day, giving us courage, love, and the words to share God’s love with others.

## Quiz — 4 Questions (with helpful scaffolding)

**1. What did the disciples hear and see when the Holy Spirit came?**
- A) A quiet whisper and soft lights
- B) A sound like a strong wind and something like flames of fire resting on them
- C) Only darkness and silence
- D) Lots of birds flying around

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “It was powerful! The sound was like a strong wind, and they saw something like fire resting on each person.”
- If C: “It was bright and loud. God wanted everyone to know the Holy Spirit had come in a special way.”
- If D: “It wasn’t birds. It was the sound of wind and the sight of fire-like flames.”

**2. What amazing thing happened when the disciples began to speak?**
- A) Everyone fell asleep
- B) The crowd heard them speaking in their own languages, even though the disciples had never learned those languages
- C) The room got very quiet
- D) Only Peter could speak

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “The crowd was wide awake and amazed! They could understand the message in their own languages.”
- If C: “It was very noisy with praise and many people talking. God wanted the good news to be heard clearly.”
- If D: “All the disciples were speaking. The Holy Spirit gave them the words in languages they had never learned.”

**3. What did Peter tell the crowd to do?**
- A) “Go home and forget everything you saw”
- B) “Repent and be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins”
- C) “Only listen to me and no one else”
- D) “Stay away from the temple”

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “Peter wanted them to turn to Jesus and be baptized. This was the beginning of a whole new life with God.”
- If C: “Peter pointed everyone to Jesus, not to himself. He wanted them to know and follow the Savior.”
- If D: “Peter invited them to come into God’s family through Jesus. It was an open and joyful invitation.”

**4. What does the coming of the Holy Spirit mean for us every day?**
- A) We have to stay in one room forever
- B) The Helper Jesus promised lives in us, giving us courage, love, and power to live for God every single day
- C) We never need to talk to anyone about Jesus
- D) Only a few special people can know God

*Correct: B*  
Wrong answers scaffolding:
- If A: “The Holy Spirit was given so we can go out and share God’s love with the world, not stay hidden.”
- If C: “The Spirit gives us the words and the courage to tell others about Jesus every day.”
- If D: “The Holy Spirit is for everyone who trusts in Jesus. He helps ordinary people like you and me live for God.”
